$comment: The colour-role contract for @gjuoun/bigface-business-ui. A theme file (src/themes/<id>.css, generated by scripts/gen-tokens.ts from src/themes/roles.ts) sets ONLY these variables. Colour only: every size, radius, shadow geometry, font and motion value is Tailwind or shadcn own. scripts/theme-check.ts enforces it.
$modes: Every theme file has a light block and a dark block, and the dark block restates every required role. A role may differ per mode.

required.--theme-primary: Primary action AND the selected state (CTA, active nav, pressed toggles, current page)
required.--theme-on-primary: Text/icons on primary. The fill ink is the mode's own darkest readable value: light fg, dark canvas (ruling 2026-10-26)
required.--theme-primary-edge: Darker primary — the CTA's bottom edge, banner border
required.--theme-frame: App frame (sidebar), dark code boxes, showcase hero
required.--theme-gray-100: Neutral ramp, subtlest fill (zebra rows, addons)
required.--theme-gray-600: Neutral ramp (labels, KPI titles, total row)
required.--theme-gray-700: Neutral ramp, strongest text (card titles, secondary text)
required.--theme-info: Info — links, file actions, switch on, focus ring by default

optional.--theme-surface: Card and popover fill. Default: gray-100
optional.--theme-frame-accent: Active nav fill on frame. Default: primary-tint
optional.--theme-on-frame-accent: Active nav text on frame. Default: primary
optional.--theme-frame-border: Hairlines on frame. Default: color-mix(on-frame 8%, transparent)
optional.--theme-primary-tint: 10% primary fill (nav hover). Default: color-mix(primary 10%, transparent)
optional.--theme-success-tint: Success badge background. Default: color-mix(success 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-danger-tint: Danger badge background. Default: color-mix(danger 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-info-tint: Info badge background. Default: color-mix(info 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-highlight-tint: Highlight badge background. Default: color-mix(highlight 12%, canvas)
optional.--theme-solid: An always-legible chip surface. Default: frame
optional.--theme-on-solid: Text/icons on a solid fill. Default: on-frame
optional.--theme-primary-fill: The brand plate: primary's FILL, always the native palette blue with on-primary ink on top. Default: primary
optional.--theme-primary-ink: Primary as text/links and the focus ring. Follows the accent blue in both modes (ruling 2026-10-24); a readable light ink is parked for Jun.
optional.--theme-black: Palette darkest: the stock scrim (bg-black/10) and the shadow tint resolve through it. Light: the ink. Dark: the canvas. Default: none
optional.--theme-white: Palette lightest, paper never #fff: the stock slider thumb (bg-white) resolves through it. Light: paper. Dark: the ink. Default: none
optional.--theme-accent-blue: The accent blue as text or a mark on its plate (the palette's own hue in both modes).
optional.--theme-plate-blue: The deepened plate the accent blue is read on: the lightest mix of it into the dark ink that still gives the accent 4.5:1 as text.
